data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 书架高处
data.description: 她看中书架最上层的一本书，却先问了店员能否借用梯子。书取下来后，她翻开目录，很快找到了想看的章节。
data.action: 站在书架前查看高处的书
data.promptProse: Standing on the brass rungs of a rolling wooden library ladder in an atmospheric antiquarian bookshop, Ho'olheyak gazes upward along towering mahogany shelves stacked to the ceiling with gold-leaf tomes. Warm ambient lamplight catches her grey hair and the intricate leather bindings, highlighting a serene book-browsing moment in the sunlit aisle.
